title: HVAC thermostat control
goal: Show a rated 24 V HVAC control circuit from transformer through thermostat terminals to furnace and condenser control devices.

rubric.must: T1 CONTROL TRANSFORMER is visible with a 120 V : 24 V AC, 40 VA rating.
U1 THERMOSTAT visibly shows terminals R, W, Y, G, and C.
A K1 FURNACE HEAT RELAY rated 24 V AC, 0.2 A is visible.
A K2 FURNACE FAN RELAY rated 24 V AC, 0.2 A is visible.
A K3 COMPRESSOR CONTACTOR with 24 V AC coil and 30 A contacts is visible.
U2 CONDENSER UNIT is visible with a 3 ton rating.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. The control transformer steps 120 V to 24 V, the thermostat's R, W, Y, G and C terminals each go where the trade puts them — heat relay, fan relay, compressor contactor — and every load returns on the 24 V common, with hop marks on the crossings.
